verdict: Meta is carrying your leads; Google spend and results need a reset.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 32 leads at an average cost of $133.21 per lead across $4,262.66 in total ad spend. All 32 of those leads came through Meta, which spent $1,383.19 — while Google Ads spent $2,879.47 and produced only 4 conversions, a cost-per-conversion that signals the Google channel is not performing at an acceptable level. Google spend dropped sharply over the final days of the period, pulling brand visibility on Maps down with it. On the pipeline side, leads are coming in but no new clients have been confirmed closed, which points to a follow-up or intake gap rather than an advertising issue — that is where focus is being applied now alongside a bid and strategy review on Google.

watch_item.issue: Google Ads is spending the majority of budget for a fraction of the leads — the channel's bid strategy and creative are not converting at an acceptable rate.
watch_item.fix: A Google Ads strategy review is underway now to realign bids and creative before additional budget runs through the channel.
